name: 쌍둥이 차사
hair: 검은색 갓 아래로 흘러내린 짧은 머리
outfit: 금색 자수가 놓인 밝은 회색 한복 도포
accessories: 머리 위에 얹은 커다란 검은 갓
weapon: 형광 연두색 빛을 내뿜는 긴 쇠사슬 낫
silhouette: 커다란 갓의 챙과 어깨를 잇는 두 명의 실루엣, 길게 뻗은 낫의 곡선
signature_motion: 몸이 좌우로 갈라지며 두 개의 작은 차사로 분열함
signature_vfx: 분열 시 발생하는 밝은 연두색 영혼의 파편
visual_en: A twin-bodied entity with pale white skin, wearing a large black traditional Gat hat with a bright red tassel. The twins are joined at the shoulders by a glowing neon green magical chain. They wear light grey Hanbok robes adorned with ornate gold embroidery and cloud patterns. Their eyes glow intensely with a piercing neon green light. Each twin holds a long, curved scythe made of dark metal, trailing bright neon green spiritual energy. The silhouette is defined by the wide brim of the hats and the interconnected shoulder structure, with bright gold and neon green accents standing out sharply against the dark environment.
pose_en: Standing side-by-side, rigidly connected, looking forward with a menacing glare.
vfx_en: Explosive shards of neon green spiritual light during split.
motion_en: Splitting into two smaller individual entities
lore: 쓰러지면 늘 둘로 쪼개진다(발룸처럼 — 쪼개진 졸개 판 px36).
concept: 저승길 — 한국 저승 설화(저승차사 · 옥졸 · 삼도천 · 명부 · 염라). 무섭되 이 게임의 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

body_plan.body: A small, stylized humanoid character wearing a large wide-brimmed hat and a long grey robe.

frame_notes.hit_0: Flinching backward from a hit, a few small green sparks near its chest, the whole body clearly visible in its own colors
